name: zkUSD Dollar
oneLiner: zkUSD is a Goal3 sportsbook dollar token on ZKsync Era, redeemed 1:1 to USDC; the protocol claims overcollateralization but composition is undisclosed.
collateral: Collateralized assets held within the Goal3 sportsbook on ZKsync Era; backing is asserted as algorithmically over-collateralized and provable on-chain, but the exact composition of accepted collateral is not publicly itemized.
pegMechanism: Issued and redeemed through the Goal3 Portal at 1 zkUSD = 1 USDC; the protocol claims to maintain over-collateralization of zkUSD circulating supply against assets held by Goal3 on ZKsync Era.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: zkUSD resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

notices.title: Reserve composition not publicly itemized
notices.message: Goal3 documents zkUSD as algorithmically over-collateralized by assets held in the sportsbook, but the specific accepted collateral assets and collateralization ratio are not published. The only documented holder exit is 1:1 redemption to USDC through the Goal3 Portal.

reserves.name: Goal3 sportsbook collateral pool (composition not disclosed)

mintAuthority.summary: zkUSD is issued and redeemed only through the Goal3 Portal on ZKsync Era at 1 zkUSD = 1 USDC; Goal3 operates the mint/redeem gateway against an undisclosed sportsbook collateral pool, with no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route.

controls.label: Goal3 Portal mint/redeem operator
controls.evidence: Goal3 docs state the official mint/redemption gateway is the Goal3 Portal, where 1 zkUSD is always redeemable for 1 USDC and supply is asserted to be over-collateralized by assets Goal3 holds in the sportsbook; minting is operator-controlled with no open user-deposit CDP route.

review.evidence: Goal3 documents zkUSD as a synthetic dollar minted and redeemed through the Goal3 Portal at 1:1 with USDC, backed by an undisclosed over-collateralized sportsbook asset pool; the only documented holder exit is portal redemption, indicating a centralized issuer-controlled mint rather than a permissionless vault.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Mechanism resolved from Goal3 documentation (portal-gated 1:1 mint/redeem); the ZKsync Era token's on-chain mint authority was not independently read.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the zkUSD token owner/minter role on ZKsync Era and the actual collateral composition and ratio behind the over-collateralization claim.
